about: PI's built-in medication list. Suggestions only: the admin confirms every field against the pharmacy label or prescriber order. Dose and times are never filled from this list. Psychotropic and controlled values follow drug class and the federal DEA schedule. Uses and side effects are plain-language summaries of FDA labeling and should be spot-checked by a nurse or pharmacist before release.
any_med_bad_reaction: Any medication: hives, swelling of the face, lips or throat, or trouble breathing. Call 911.

meds.name: Acetaminophen
meds.bad_reaction: More than 4,000 mg in a day, or yellow skin or eyes, dark urine. Call Poison Control (1-800-222-1222) or the prescriber now.

meds.name: Acetazolamide
meds.side_effects: Tingling, taste changes, urinating more, tiredness
meds.bad_reaction: Rash, fast breathing, confusion, side or back pain. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Albuterol
meds.bad_reaction: Breathing gets worse after use, chest pain. Call 911.

meds.name: Alendronate
meds.side_effects: Heartburn, stomach pain. Give first thing with a full glass of water; upright for 30 minutes; no food for 30 minutes.
meds.bad_reaction: Pain or trouble swallowing, chest pain, jaw pain, new thigh pain. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Allopurinol
meds.bad_reaction: Any rash, especially with fever or mouth sores. Stop and call the prescriber the same day.

meds.name: Alprazolam
meds.side_effects: Sleepiness, dizziness, unsteady walking, memory problems
meds.bad_reaction: Slow or shallow breathing, very hard to wake, falls. Call 911 for breathing problems.

meds.name: Amantadine
meds.side_effects: Dizziness, dry mouth, trouble sleeping, purple blotchy skin on legs
meds.bad_reaction: Seeing things that aren't there, confusion, fainting. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Amitriptyline
meds.side_effects: Sleepiness, dry mouth, constipation, blurry vision, trouble urinating, weight gain
meds.bad_reaction: Fast or irregular heartbeat, fainting, confusion, can't urinate. Call 911 for fainting or chest symptoms.

meds.name: Amlodipine
meds.bad_reaction: Fainting, chest pain that's new or worse. Call 911.

meds.name: Amoxicillin
uses: Bacterial infections (ear, throat, sinus, lung, urinary)
meds.bad_reaction: Hives, swelling or trouble breathing; watery or bloody diarrhea. Call 911 for breathing problems. Check penicillin allergy first.

meds.name: Amoxicillin and clavulanate
meds.side_effects: Diarrhea, upset stomach. Give with food.
meds.bad_reaction: Hives, swelling or trouble breathing; watery or bloody diarrhea; yellow skin. Call 911 for breathing problems.

meds.name: Amphetamine and dextroamphetamine
meds.side_effects: Less appetite, trouble sleeping, dry mouth, fast heartbeat, irritability
meds.bad_reaction: Chest pain, fainting, seeing or hearing things that aren't there. Call 911 for chest pain or fainting.

meds.name: Apixaban
meds.bad_reaction: Black or bloody stools, vomiting blood, a fall with head injury, bleeding that won't stop. Call 911.

meds.name: Aripiprazole
meds.side_effects: Restlessness, upset stomach, headache, sleepiness or trouble sleeping, weight gain
meds.bad_reaction: High fever with stiff muscles or confusion; repeated face or tongue movements; new urges (gambling, eating). Call the prescriber; call 911 for high fever with stiffness.

meds.name: Artificial tears
meds.bad_reaction: Eye pain or vision changes. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Aspirin low dose
meds.bad_reaction: Black or bloody stools, vomiting blood, ringing ears. Call the prescriber; call 911 for heavy bleeding.

meds.name: Atomoxetine
meds.side_effects: Upset stomach, less appetite, sleepiness, dizziness
meds.bad_reaction: Thoughts of self-harm; yellow skin or eyes, dark urine. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Atorvastatin
meds.side_effects: Muscle aches, joint pain, upset stomach
meds.bad_reaction: Severe muscle pain or weakness with dark urine; yellow skin or eyes. Call the prescriber the same day.

meds.name: Azithromycin
meds.bad_reaction: Fainting or irregular heartbeat; watery or bloody diarrhea. Call 911 for fainting.

meds.name: Bacitracin and polymyxin ointment
meds.bad_reaction: Rash or spreading redness. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Baclofen
meds.bad_reaction: Very hard to wake, slow breathing, seizures or seeing things if doses are missed. Don't stop suddenly. Call 911 for breathing problems.

meds.name: Benzonatate
meds.side_effects: Sleepiness, dizziness, upset stomach. Swallow whole; don't chew.
meds.bad_reaction: Choking or numb mouth and throat if chewed, confusion. Call 911 for choking.

meds.name: Benztropine
meds.side_effects: Dry mouth, constipation, blurry vision, trouble urinating
meds.bad_reaction: Confusion, can't urinate, overheating (can't sweat). Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Bisacodyl
meds.bad_reaction: Severe belly pain, vomiting, rectal bleeding. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Brexpiprazole
meds.bad_reaction: High fever with stiff muscles, repeated face movements, new urges. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Brivaracetam
meds.bad_reaction: New aggression, depression or thoughts of self-harm. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Budesonide and formoterol
meds.side_effects: Hoarse voice, thrush in the mouth (rinse after use), headache
meds.bad_reaction: Breathing gets worse after use, white patches in the mouth that don't go away. Call the prescriber; call 911 for trouble breathing.

meds.name: Bupropion
meds.side_effects: Trouble sleeping, dry mouth, headache, less appetite, nervousness
meds.bad_reaction: Seizure; thoughts of self-harm or agitation. Call 911 for a seizure. Don't crush extended-release tablets.

meds.name: Buspirone
meds.bad_reaction: Fever with stiff muscles, shaking or confusion. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Calcium carbonate
meds.side_effects: Constipation, gas. Large tablet; give with food and water, upright.
meds.bad_reaction: Trouble swallowing the tablet, nausea or confusion (too much calcium). Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Cannabidiol
meds.bad_reaction: Yellow skin or eyes, dark urine, belly pain. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Carbamazepine
meds.side_effects: Dizziness, unsteady walking, sleepiness, upset stomach, blurred vision
meds.bad_reaction: Rash or blisters, fever, sore throat, mouth sores, unusual bruising, confusion. Call the prescriber the same day.

meds.name: Carbamide peroxide ear drops
meds.side_effects: Bubbling or fullness in the ear
meds.bad_reaction: Ear pain, drainage, dizziness. Stop and call the prescriber.

meds.name: Carbidopa and levodopa
meds.side_effects: Upset stomach, dizziness when standing, sleepiness, uncontrolled movements
meds.bad_reaction: Seeing things that aren't there, sudden sleep, fainting. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Cariprazine
meds.bad_reaction: High fever with stiff muscles, repeated face movements. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Carvedilol
meds.bad_reaction: Fainting, very slow heartbeat, swelling and weight gain. Call 911 for fainting.

meds.name: Cenobamate
meds.bad_reaction: Rash with fever or swollen glands, fainting. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Cephalexin
uses: Skin, urinary, bone and throat infections
meds.bad_reaction: Hives, swelling or trouble breathing; watery or bloody diarrhea. Call 911 for breathing problems.

meds.name: Cetirizine
meds.bad_reaction: Can't urinate, unusual restlessness. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Chlorhexidine oral rinse
meds.side_effects: Teeth staining, taste changes. Don't swallow.
meds.bad_reaction: Swelling of the mouth or face. Call 911 for trouble breathing.

meds.name: Chlorpromazine
meds.side_effects: Sleepiness, dizziness when standing, dry mouth, constipation, sun sensitivity
meds.bad_reaction: High fever with stiff muscles, yellow skin or eyes, repeated face movements. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Ciprofloxacin
meds.side_effects: Upset stomach, diarrhea, dizziness. Keep apart from calcium, iron and dairy.
meds.bad_reaction: Tendon pain or swelling (heel), confusion, seizure, irregular heartbeat. Stop and call the prescriber; call 911 for seizure.

meds.name: Ciprofloxacin ear or eye drops
meds.bad_reaction: Rash, swelling, worsening pain. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Citalopram
meds.side_effects: Upset stomach, sleepiness or trouble sleeping, sweating, dry mouth
meds.bad_reaction: Fainting or racing, irregular heartbeat; thoughts of self-harm. Call the prescriber; call 911 for fainting.

meds.name: Clindamycin
uses: Skin, bone, dental and lung infections
meds.bad_reaction: Watery or bloody diarrhea, even weeks later (C. diff). Call the prescriber the same day.

meds.name: Clobazam
meds.side_effects: Sleepiness, drooling, irritability, constipation, unsteady walking
meds.bad_reaction: Very hard to wake, slow breathing, rash with blisters. Call 911 for breathing problems.

meds.name: Clonazepam
meds.side_effects: Sleepiness, unsteady walking, drooling, behavior changes
meds.bad_reaction: Slow or shallow breathing, very hard to wake, thoughts of self-harm. Call 911 for breathing problems.

meds.name: Clonidine
meds.bad_reaction: Fainting, very slow heartbeat. Don't stop suddenly (blood pressure can spike). Call 911 for fainting.

meds.name: Clopidogrel
meds.bad_reaction: Black or bloody stools, vomiting blood, bleeding that won't stop. Call 911 for heavy bleeding.

meds.name: Clotrimazole
meds.bad_reaction: Blistering or swelling. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Clozapine
uses: Schizophrenia that other medicines didn't help
meds.side_effects: Drooling, sleepiness, constipation, weight gain, dizziness, fast heartbeat
meds.bad_reaction: Fever, sore throat or flu symptoms (low white cells); no bowel movement for 2 or more days or belly pain; chest pain; seizure. Call the prescriber the same day; call 911 for chest pain or seizure. Requires regular blood tests.

meds.name: Cranberry supplement
meds.bad_reaction: Bleeding with warfarin. Tell the prescriber if they take a blood thinner.

meds.name: Cyanocobalamin (vitamin B12)
meds.bad_reaction: Rash or swelling. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Cyclobenzaprine
meds.bad_reaction: Fast or irregular heartbeat, confusion. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Dantrolene
meds.bad_reaction: Yellow skin or eyes, dark urine, belly pain. Call the prescriber the same day.

meds.name: Desmopressin
meds.side_effects: Headache, upset stomach. Limit fluids in the evening.
meds.bad_reaction: Headache with confusion, vomiting, seizure (low sodium). Call 911 for seizure.

meds.name: Desvenlafaxine
meds.side_effects: Upset stomach, dizziness, sweating, trouble sleeping
meds.bad_reaction: Thoughts of self-harm; fever with stiff muscles or confusion. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Dexmethylphenidate
meds.side_effects: Less appetite, trouble sleeping, stomach ache, headache
meds.bad_reaction: Chest pain, fainting, seeing or hearing things that aren't there. Call 911 for chest pain or fainting.

meds.name: Diazepam
meds.side_effects: Sleepiness, unsteady walking, tiredness, muscle weakness
meds.bad_reaction: Slow or shallow breathing, very hard to wake. Call 911.

meds.name: Diazepam nasal spray
meds.bad_reaction: Slow or shallow breathing, can't be woken. Call 911.

meds.name: Diazepam rectal gel
meds.bad_reaction: Slow or shallow breathing, can't be woken. Call 911.

meds.name: Diclofenac gel
meds.bad_reaction: Black stools, swelling, rash. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Digoxin
meds.bad_reaction: Vomiting, less appetite, blurry or yellow-green vision, slow or irregular heartbeat (too much). Call the prescriber now.

meds.name: Diphenhydramine
meds.side_effects: Sleepiness, dry mouth, constipation, confusion in older adults
meds.bad_reaction: Confusion, can't urinate, very fast heartbeat. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Divalproex sodium
meds.side_effects: Upset stomach, sleepiness, tremor, weight gain, hair thinning
meds.bad_reaction: Belly pain with vomiting, yellow skin or eyes, unusual bruising or bleeding, confusion. Call the prescriber the same day.

meds.name: Docusate sodium
meds.bad_reaction: No bowel movement in 3 days, vomiting, swollen hard belly. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Donepezil
meds.side_effects: Upset stomach, diarrhea, less appetite, vivid dreams, slow heartbeat
meds.bad_reaction: Fainting, black stools or vomiting blood, seizure. Call 911 for fainting or seizure.

meds.name: Doxepin low dose
meds.bad_reaction: Confusion, sleepwalking, thoughts of self-harm. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Doxycycline
meds.side_effects: Upset stomach, sun sensitivity. Give with a full glass of water, upright for 30 minutes.
meds.bad_reaction: Pain when swallowing or chest pain after a dose, bad headache with vision changes. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Duloxetine
meds.side_effects: Upset stomach, dry mouth, sleepiness, constipation, less appetite
meds.bad_reaction: Yellow skin or eyes, dark urine; thoughts of self-harm; fever with stiff muscles. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Epinephrine auto-injector
meds.side_effects: Fast heartbeat, shakiness, pale skin, anxiety
meds.bad_reaction: Always call 911 after using it.

meds.name: Ergocalciferol (vitamin D2)
meds.bad_reaction: Nausea, constipation, confusion, very thirsty (too much). Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Escitalopram
meds.side_effects: Upset stomach, trouble sleeping, sleepiness, sweating
meds.bad_reaction: Thoughts of self-harm or sudden behavior change; fever with stiff muscles, shaking or confusion. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Esomeprazole
meds.bad_reaction: Watery diarrhea that won't stop, black stools. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Ethinyl estradiol and norethindrone
meds.bad_reaction: Leg pain or swelling, chest pain, sudden severe headache, vision loss. Call 911.

meds.name: Ethosuximide
meds.side_effects: Upset stomach, less appetite, sleepiness, headache
meds.bad_reaction: Rash, fever, sore throat, unusual bruising. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Famotidine
meds.bad_reaction: Confusion, irregular heartbeat. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Felbamate
meds.side_effects: Less appetite, trouble sleeping, upset stomach, headache
meds.bad_reaction: Fever, sore throat, unusual bruising (blood problems); yellow skin or eyes. Call the prescriber the same day.

meds.name: Fenfluramine
meds.bad_reaction: Shortness of breath, chest pain, swelling (heart valve problems). Call the prescriber. Requires heart scans.

meds.name: Ferrous sulfate
meds.side_effects: Constipation, dark stools, upset stomach. Keep apart from calcium and thyroid medicine.
meds.bad_reaction: Belly pain with vomiting, black tarry stools with weakness. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Fexofenadine
meds.bad_reaction: Rash, fast heartbeat. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Fiber supplement (psyllium)
meds.side_effects: Gas, bloating. Mix with a full glass of liquid.
meds.bad_reaction: Choking or chest pain if not mixed with enough liquid, trouble swallowing. Call 911 for choking.

meds.name: Finasteride
meds.bad_reaction: Breast lumps or pain, depression. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Fluconazole
meds.bad_reaction: Fainting or irregular heartbeat, yellow skin or eyes, rash. Call the prescriber; call 911 for fainting.

meds.name: Fluoxetine
meds.side_effects: Nervousness, trouble sleeping, upset stomach, headache, less appetite
meds.bad_reaction: Thoughts of self-harm or sudden behavior change; fever with stiff muscles, shaking or confusion. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Fluphenazine
meds.side_effects: Stiffness, tremor, restlessness, sleepiness, dry mouth
meds.bad_reaction: High fever with stiff muscles or confusion, neck or eye spasms, repeated face movements. Call 911 for high fever with stiffness.

meds.name: Fluticasone and salmeterol
meds.side_effects: Hoarse voice, thrush in the mouth (rinse after use), headache
meds.bad_reaction: Breathing gets worse after use. Call 911.

meds.name: Fluticasone nasal
meds.bad_reaction: Frequent nosebleeds, vision changes. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Fluvoxamine
meds.side_effects: Upset stomach, sleepiness, trouble sleeping, headache
meds.bad_reaction: Thoughts of self-harm; fever with stiff muscles or confusion. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Folic acid
meds.bad_reaction: Rash. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Furosemide
meds.bad_reaction: Muscle cramps or weakness, confusion, very dry mouth, fainting. Call the prescriber; call 911 for fainting.

meds.name: Gabapentin
meds.side_effects: Sleepiness, dizziness, unsteady walking, swelling of hands or feet
meds.bad_reaction: Slow or shallow breathing, very hard to wake, new mood changes. Call 911 for breathing problems.

meds.name: Glipizide
meds.side_effects: Low blood sugar, dizziness, upset stomach
meds.bad_reaction: Shaky, sweaty, confused or hard to wake (low blood sugar). Give sugar if they can swallow; call 911 if they can't.

meds.name: Glycopyrrolate
meds.side_effects: Dry mouth, constipation, flushing, trouble urinating
meds.bad_reaction: Overheating, can't urinate, severe constipation. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Guaifenesin
meds.bad_reaction: Cough lasting over 7 days or with fever. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Guanfacine
meds.side_effects: Sleepiness, tiredness, dizziness, low blood pressure, dry mouth
meds.bad_reaction: Fainting, very slow heartbeat. Don't stop suddenly (blood pressure can spike). Call 911 for fainting.

meds.name: Haloperidol
meds.side_effects: Stiffness, tremor, restlessness, sleepiness, dry mouth
meds.bad_reaction: High fever with stiff muscles or confusion, neck or eye muscle spasms, repeated face movements, fainting. Call 911 for high fever with stiffness.

meds.name: Hydralazine
meds.bad_reaction: Joint pain with fever and rash, chest pain. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Hydrochlorothiazide
meds.bad_reaction: Muscle cramps or weakness, confusion, sudden eye pain. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Hydrocodone and acetaminophen
meds.bad_reaction: Slow or shallow breathing, can't be woken, blue lips. Give naloxone if prescribed and call 911.

meds.name: Hydrocortisone cream
meds.side_effects: Mild burning or thinning skin with long use
meds.bad_reaction: Rash that spreads or looks infected. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Hydroxyzine
meds.bad_reaction: Fainting or irregular heartbeat, shaking, confusion. Call 911 for fainting.

meds.name: Ibuprofen
meds.side_effects: Upset stomach, heartburn. Give with food.
meds.bad_reaction: Black or bloody stools, vomiting blood, chest pain, swelling. Call the prescriber; call 911 for chest pain or heavy bleeding.

meds.name: Insulin glargine
meds.side_effects: Low blood sugar, weight gain, redness where injected
meds.bad_reaction: Shaky, sweaty, confused or hard to wake (low blood sugar). Give sugar if they can swallow; call 911 if they can't.

meds.name: Insulin lispro
meds.side_effects: Low blood sugar, redness where injected
meds.bad_reaction: Shaky, sweaty, confused or hard to wake (low blood sugar). Give sugar if they can swallow; call 911 if they can't.

meds.name: Ipratropium and albuterol
meds.bad_reaction: Breathing gets worse after use, chest pain. Call 911.

meds.name: Ketoconazole topical
meds.bad_reaction: Blistering or swelling. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Ketotifen eye drops
meds.bad_reaction: Eye pain or vision changes. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Lacosamide
meds.side_effects: Dizziness, double vision, headache, upset stomach, unsteady walking
meds.bad_reaction: Fainting, very slow or irregular heartbeat. Call the prescriber; call 911 if they pass out.

meds.name: Lactulose
meds.bad_reaction: Many watery stools, dizziness or weakness (dehydration). Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Lamotrigine
meds.side_effects: Dizziness, double vision, headache, upset stomach, sleepiness
meds.bad_reaction: Any new rash, especially with fever, blisters or mouth sores. Stop and call the prescriber the same day.

meds.name: Latanoprost
meds.side_effects: Eye redness, darker iris or eyelashes over time
meds.bad_reaction: Eye pain, swelling or vision changes. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Levetiracetam
meds.side_effects: Sleepiness, dizziness, weakness, irritability or mood changes
meds.bad_reaction: New or worse aggression, depression, or thoughts of self-harm; seizures that increase. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Levothyroxine
meds.side_effects: Usually none at the right dose. Give on an empty stomach, apart from calcium and iron.
meds.bad_reaction: Racing heartbeat, chest pain, shaking, sweating, weight loss. Call the prescriber; call 911 for chest pain.

meds.name: Lidocaine patch
meds.bad_reaction: Dizziness, slow heartbeat, confusion (too much). Remove the patch and call the prescriber.

meds.name: Lisdexamfetamine
meds.side_effects: Less appetite, trouble sleeping, dry mouth, irritability
meds.bad_reaction: Chest pain, fainting, seeing or hearing things that aren't there. Call 911 for chest pain or fainting.

meds.name: Lisinopril
meds.bad_reaction: Swelling of the face, lips, tongue or throat. Call 911.

meds.name: Lithium carbonate
meds.side_effects: Thirst, urinating more, fine hand tremor, upset stomach, weight gain
meds.bad_reaction: Vomiting or diarrhea, coarse shaking, unsteady walking, slurred speech or confusion (toxic level). Call the prescriber now; call 911 if very confused. Needs regular blood tests.

meds.name: Loperamide
meds.bad_reaction: Swollen belly, fainting or irregular heartbeat. Call the prescriber; call 911 for fainting.

meds.name: Loratadine
meds.bad_reaction: Fast heartbeat, rash. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Lorazepam
meds.bad_reaction: Slow or shallow breathing, very hard to wake, confusion or falls. Call 911 for breathing problems.

meds.name: Losartan
meds.bad_reaction: Fainting, swelling of face or throat, very slow or irregular heartbeat (high potassium). Call 911.

meds.name: Lurasidone
meds.side_effects: Sleepiness, restlessness, upset stomach. Take with food.
meds.bad_reaction: High fever with stiff muscles, repeated face movements, thoughts of self-harm. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Magnesium oxide
meds.bad_reaction: Weakness, very slow heartbeat, confusion (too much). Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Mebendazole
meds.bad_reaction: Seizure, rash, fever. Call the prescriber; call 911 for seizure.

meds.name: Medroxyprogesterone injection
meds.bad_reaction: Leg pain or swelling, chest pain, severe headache. Call 911.

meds.name: Melatonin
meds.bad_reaction: Unusual confusion or very hard to wake. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Meloxicam
meds.bad_reaction: Black or bloody stools, chest pain, shortness of breath. Call 911 for chest pain.

meds.name: Memantine
meds.bad_reaction: Seeing things that aren't there, sudden confusion. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Metformin
meds.side_effects: Upset stomach, diarrhea, gas, metallic taste. Give with meals.
meds.bad_reaction: Unusual muscle pain, trouble breathing, belly pain with weakness (lactic acidosis). Call 911.

meds.name: Methocarbamol
meds.bad_reaction: Fainting, very hard to wake. Call 911 for fainting.

meds.name: Methylphenidate
meds.side_effects: Less appetite, trouble sleeping, stomach ache, headache, irritability
meds.bad_reaction: Chest pain, fainting, seeing or hearing things that aren't there, fingers or toes turning white or blue. Call 911 for chest pain or fainting.

meds.name: Metoclopramide
meds.bad_reaction: Repeated face, tongue or body movements; muscle spasms; depression. Stop and call the prescriber.

meds.name: Metoprolol
meds.side_effects: Tiredness, dizziness, slow heartbeat, cold hands
meds.bad_reaction: Fainting, very slow heartbeat, shortness of breath. Don't stop suddenly. Call 911 for fainting.

meds.name: Midazolam nasal spray
meds.bad_reaction: Slow or shallow breathing, can't be woken. Call 911.

meds.name: Mirtazapine
meds.side_effects: Sleepiness, more appetite, weight gain, dry mouth
meds.bad_reaction: Fever, sore throat or mouth sores (low white cells); thoughts of self-harm. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Mometasone nasal
meds.bad_reaction: Frequent nosebleeds, vision changes. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Montelukast
meds.bad_reaction: Mood or behavior changes, nightmares, thoughts of self-harm. Stop and call the prescriber.

meds.name: Multivitamin
meds.bad_reaction: Trouble swallowing the tablet. Ask about a chewable or liquid form.

meds.name: Mupirocin
meds.bad_reaction: Rash, spreading redness or swelling. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Naloxone nasal spray
meds.bad_reaction: Always call 911 after giving it. Overdose can return when it wears off.

meds.name: Naltrexone
meds.bad_reaction: Yellow skin or eyes, dark urine, belly pain. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Naproxen
meds.side_effects: Upset stomach, heartburn, dizziness. Give with food.
meds.bad_reaction: Black or bloody stools, vomiting blood, chest pain. Call 911 for chest pain or heavy bleeding.

meds.name: Nicotine replacement
meds.side_effects: Skin irritation (patch), vivid dreams, upset stomach
meds.bad_reaction: Fast or irregular heartbeat, severe dizziness. Remove the patch and call the prescriber.

meds.name: Nitrofurantoin
meds.side_effects: Upset stomach, headache, brown urine. Give with food.
meds.bad_reaction: Cough, chest pain or trouble breathing; numbness or tingling. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Nitroglycerin
meds.bad_reaction: Chest pain not better 5 minutes after the first dose: call 911.

meds.name: Norethindrone
meds.bad_reaction: Leg pain or swelling, severe headache, vision changes. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Nortriptyline
meds.side_effects: Dry mouth, constipation, sleepiness, blurry vision
meds.bad_reaction: Fast or irregular heartbeat, fainting, confusion. Call 911 for fainting.

meds.name: Nystatin
meds.bad_reaction: Rash or swelling. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Olanzapine
meds.side_effects: Weight gain, more appetite, sleepiness, dry mouth, constipation
meds.bad_reaction: High fever with stiff muscles or confusion, very high thirst and urination, repeated face movements. Call the prescriber; call 911 for high fever with stiffness.

meds.name: Omeprazole
meds.bad_reaction: Watery diarrhea that won't stop, black stools, muscle cramps or shaking. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Ondansetron
meds.bad_reaction: Fainting or irregular heartbeat. Call 911 for fainting.

meds.name: Oseltamivir
meds.bad_reaction: Confusion, unusual behavior, seeing things. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Oxcarbazepine
meds.side_effects: Dizziness, sleepiness, double vision, upset stomach, headache
meds.bad_reaction: Confusion, unusual tiredness or headache (low sodium), rash. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Oxybutynin
meds.side_effects: Dry mouth, constipation, blurry vision, sleepiness
meds.bad_reaction: Confusion, can't urinate, overheating. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Oxycodone
meds.bad_reaction: Slow or shallow breathing, can't be woken, blue lips. Give naloxone if prescribed and call 911.

meds.name: Paliperidone
meds.side_effects: Restlessness, stiffness, sleepiness, weight gain, fast heartbeat
meds.bad_reaction: Fainting, high fever with stiff muscles, repeated face movements. Call the prescriber; call 911 for fainting.

meds.name: Pantoprazole
meds.bad_reaction: Watery diarrhea that won't stop, black stools. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Paroxetine
meds.side_effects: Sleepiness, upset stomach, dry mouth, sweating, constipation
meds.bad_reaction: Thoughts of self-harm; fever with stiff muscles or confusion. Call the prescriber. Don't stop suddenly.

meds.name: Perampanel
meds.bad_reaction: Aggression, anger or thoughts of harming others or self. Call the prescriber now.

meds.name: Permethrin
meds.side_effects: Itching or burning for a few weeks
meds.bad_reaction: Severe rash or swelling. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Petroleum jelly and barrier creams
meds.bad_reaction: Rash that spreads, open sores. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Phenobarbital
meds.side_effects: Sleepiness, slowed thinking, unsteady walking, irritability
meds.bad_reaction: Very hard to wake, slow or shallow breathing, rash. Call 911 for breathing problems.

meds.name: Phenytoin
meds.side_effects: Unsteady walking, dizziness, slurred speech, gum overgrowth, sleepiness
meds.bad_reaction: Rash, fever, swollen glands, eye movements that won't stop, severe unsteadiness. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Polyethylene glycol 3350
meds.bad_reaction: Severe belly pain or swelling, vomiting, bloody stools. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Potassium chloride
meds.side_effects: Upset stomach, diarrhea. Large tablet; give with a full glass of water, sitting upright.
meds.bad_reaction: Trouble swallowing or chest pain after a dose, black stools, very slow or irregular heartbeat. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Prazosin
meds.bad_reaction: Fainting, especially after the first dose. Call 911 for fainting.

meds.name: Prednisone
meds.side_effects: More appetite, trouble sleeping, mood changes, higher blood sugar. Give with food.
meds.bad_reaction: Black stools, severe mood change, signs of infection. Don't stop suddenly after long use. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Pregabalin
meds.side_effects: Dizziness, sleepiness, weight gain, swelling, blurry vision
meds.bad_reaction: Swelling of face or throat, slow breathing, very hard to wake. Call 911.

meds.name: Primidone
meds.side_effects: Sleepiness, dizziness, unsteady walking, upset stomach
meds.bad_reaction: Very hard to wake, rash, unusual bruising. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Probiotic
meds.bad_reaction: Fever with stomach pain. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Propranolol
meds.side_effects: Tiredness, cold hands, slow heartbeat, dizziness
meds.bad_reaction: Fainting, very slow heartbeat, wheezing. Don't stop suddenly. Call 911 for fainting or trouble breathing.

meds.name: Pyridoxine (vitamin B6)
meds.bad_reaction: Numbness or tingling with long high doses. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Quetiapine
meds.side_effects: Sleepiness, dizziness when standing, dry mouth, weight gain, constipation
meds.bad_reaction: Fainting, high fever with stiff muscles, repeated face or tongue movements. Call the prescriber; call 911 for high fever with stiffness.

meds.name: Ramelteon
meds.bad_reaction: Unusual behavior during sleep, worsening mood. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Risperidone
meds.side_effects: Weight gain, sleepiness, more appetite, drooling, restlessness, stiffness
meds.bad_reaction: High fever with stiff muscles or confusion; repeated movements of the mouth, tongue or face; fainting. Call the prescriber; call 911 for high fever with stiffness.

meds.name: Ropinirole
meds.bad_reaction: Falling asleep suddenly, new urges (gambling, eating), seeing things that aren't there. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Rosuvastatin
meds.bad_reaction: Severe muscle pain or weakness with dark urine. Call the prescriber the same day.

meds.name: Rufinamide
meds.bad_reaction: Rash with fever, fainting. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Semaglutide
meds.side_effects: Upset stomach, vomiting, diarrhea, constipation, less appetite
meds.bad_reaction: Severe belly pain that goes to the back, vomiting that won't stop, lump in the neck. Call the prescriber; call 911 for severe pain.

meds.name: Sennosides
meds.bad_reaction: Severe belly pain, vomiting, no bowel movement in 3 days. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Sertraline
meds.side_effects: Upset stomach, diarrhea, trouble sleeping or sleepiness, headache, sweating
meds.bad_reaction: Thoughts of self-harm or sudden behavior change; fever with stiff muscles, shaking or confusion. Call the prescriber; call 911 for serious symptoms.

meds.name: Simethicone
meds.bad_reaction: Belly pain that gets worse. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Simvastatin
meds.bad_reaction: Severe muscle pain or weakness with dark urine. Call the prescriber the same day.

meds.name: Sodium chloride nasal spray
meds.bad_reaction: Nosebleeds that don't stop. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Sodium fluoride toothpaste
meds.bad_reaction: Upset stomach if swallowed in large amounts. Call Poison Control (1-800-222-1222).

meds.name: Spironolactone
meds.bad_reaction: Muscle weakness, very slow or irregular heartbeat (high potassium). Call 911.

meds.name: Stiripentol
meds.bad_reaction: Fever, sore throat, unusual bruising. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Sulfamethoxazole and trimethoprim
meds.side_effects: Upset stomach, less appetite, sun sensitivity. Give with plenty of water.
meds.bad_reaction: Rash, blisters or mouth sores; fever; unusual bruising. Stop and call the prescriber the same day. Check sulfa allergy first.

meds.name: Sumatriptan
meds.side_effects: Tingling, warmth, tiredness, chest tightness that passes
meds.bad_reaction: Chest pain that doesn't pass, sudden severe headache, weakness on one side. Call 911.

meds.name: Tamsulosin
meds.bad_reaction: Fainting, an erection lasting over 4 hours. Call 911.

meds.name: Tiotropium
meds.bad_reaction: Breathing gets worse after use, eye pain, can't urinate. Call the prescriber; call 911 for trouble breathing.

meds.name: Tizanidine
meds.side_effects: Sleepiness, dry mouth, weakness, dizziness, low blood pressure
meds.bad_reaction: Fainting, yellow skin or eyes, seeing things that aren't there. Call 911 for fainting.

meds.name: Topiramate
meds.side_effects: Tingling hands or feet, slowed thinking, word-finding trouble, less appetite, sleepiness
meds.bad_reaction: Sudden eye pain or blurry vision, not sweating with high temperature, side or back pain (kidney stone). Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Tramadol
meds.bad_reaction: Seizure, slow breathing, fever with stiff muscles or confusion. Call 911.

meds.name: Trazodone
meds.bad_reaction: Fainting or irregular heartbeat; an erection lasting over 4 hours. Call 911.

meds.name: Triamcinolone cream
meds.side_effects: Burning, thinning skin with long use
meds.bad_reaction: Rash that spreads or looks infected. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Trihexyphenidyl
meds.side_effects: Dry mouth, blurry vision, constipation, dizziness
meds.bad_reaction: Confusion, can't urinate, overheating. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Valacyclovir
meds.bad_reaction: Confusion, much less urine, unusual bruising. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Valbenazine
uses: Tardive dyskinesia (repeated face or body movements from antipsychotics)
meds.bad_reaction: Fainting or irregular heartbeat, depression. Call the prescriber; call 911 for fainting.

meds.name: Valproic acid
meds.side_effects: Upset stomach, sleepiness, tremor, weight gain
meds.bad_reaction: Belly pain with vomiting, yellow skin or eyes, unusual bruising or bleeding, confusion. Call the prescriber the same day.

meds.name: Venlafaxine
meds.side_effects: Upset stomach, sweating, sleepiness or trouble sleeping, dizziness, higher blood pressure
meds.bad_reaction: Thoughts of self-harm; fever with stiff muscles or confusion; very high blood pressure headache. Call the prescriber. Don't stop suddenly.

meds.name: Vigabatrin
meds.bad_reaction: Bumping into things or missing things to the side (vision loss). Call the prescriber. Requires regular eye exams.

meds.name: Vilazodone
meds.side_effects: Diarrhea, upset stomach, trouble sleeping. Give with food.
meds.bad_reaction: Thoughts of self-harm; fever with stiff muscles or confusion. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Vitamin D3 (cholecalciferol)
meds.bad_reaction: Nausea, constipation, confusion, very thirsty (too much). Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Vortioxetine
meds.bad_reaction: Thoughts of self-harm; fever with stiff muscles or confusion. Call the prescriber.

meds.name: Warfarin
meds.side_effects: Easy bruising, nosebleeds. Needs regular blood tests (INR).
meds.bad_reaction: Black or bloody stools, vomiting blood, a fall with head injury, bleeding that won't stop. Call 911.

meds.name: Ziprasidone
meds.side_effects: Sleepiness, dizziness, restlessness, upset stomach. Take with food.
meds.bad_reaction: Fainting or racing, irregular heartbeat; rash with fever; high fever with stiff muscles. Call 911 for fainting.

meds.name: Zolpidem
meds.bad_reaction: Sleepwalking, sleep-eating or driving while not awake; confusion. Stop and call the prescriber.

meds.name: Zonisamide
meds.side_effects: Sleepiness, dizziness, less appetite, slowed thinking
meds.bad_reaction: Not sweating with high temperature, rash, side or back pain (kidney stone). Call the prescriber.
